description: You are a Research Administrator looking for active funding in Quantum Computing. Navigate to the National Science Foundation (NSF) Award Search (https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/advancedSearch.jsp). Perform an advanced search for awards with the Keyword/Element Code 'Quantum Computing', located in the State of 'Massachusetts', and with an 'Active' Award Status. Identify 5 distinct active awards from the results. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'NSF Quantum Grants' and bookmark the specific award page for each of the 5 grants. Finally, compile the details into a JSON file at ~/Documents/nsf_grant_analysis.json. The file must contain a list of objects, each with: 'award_number' (7 digits), 'title', 'organization', 'start_date', and 'amount'.
